hero_sub: Aspiring Software Developer | Web Development & AI
about-me-intro-1: I am 16 and love building my own web applications. Right now, I am mainly working on Notely, a productivity app for students with notes, task management, and planned AI features.
about-me-intro-2: I build with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS while continuing to learn deliberately. Recently, that included a course on the Anthropic API, after earlier foundation certificates in HTML/CSS/JS. For me, this is not a finish line, but an ongoing process.
about-me-intro-3: I am especially interested in how an idea moves from the first concept to a finished, useful product. Not only the code, but also product decisions and how real users actually work with a tool.
about-me-intro-4: I am still a student and teach myself in a focused way through projects, courses, and conversations with others. I am happy to connect with other developers, get feedback on Notely, and find opportunities to gain practical experience.
contact_description: If you have any questions or would like to get in touch with me, please don't hesitate to send me a message. I look forward to hearing from you!
cv_description: Here you can find my CV, which provides an overview of my education, work experience, skills, and projects. If you have any questions or would like to learn more about my background, please feel free to contact me.
